issue.title: HYP-105 B3.2-E1-B: all-label six-motif Ω(s^6) obstruction or infinite correlated counterexample
issue.body:
Parent [HYP-105 #176](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/issues/176), upstream [#169](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/issues/169). Follows merged [#224](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/pull/224), merged [#225](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/pull/225), and finite E1-A [PR #227](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/pull/227).

## Objective: prove a nontrivial ALL-h statement, not fit finite W32 observations

Let f_s,g_s range over ALL injective maps from the V_s=(s+1)(s^2+1) typed factor vertices of W(3,s), s=2^h, into unordered physical coordinate pairs of K_{a_s}, a_s=min{a:binom(a,2)>=V_s}. Let D6, U_B_left/right and U_CA/U_CB/U_BB_overlap/U_BB_disjoint count ORIGINAL DISTINCT six-incidence factor sets satisfying accepted positive six-coordinate GF5 classes, NOT signed-event counts or physical label automorphism orbits.

Accepted all-h fixed-label necessary R3 floor:

```text
51^6 R3(f_s,g_s) >=
5643 D6 + 45600(U_B_left + U_B_right)
+ 43320 U_CA + 49050 U_CB
+ 51750 U_BB_overlap + 45010 U_BB_disjoint.
```

## Disjunctive proof gate

**Branch A — universal obstruction:** prove `inf_{f_s,g_s} S_s(f_s,g_s) = Omega(s^6)` for S equal the sum of those seven disjoint motif multiplicities. Then no allowed deterministic pair-label family reaches R3=O(s^(6-eps)) via this particular GQ construction / classical alteration. Beware this would NOT rule out all general weighted ASET constructions or other hypergraph-extraction algorithms. Prove all h with positive constant independent of h and no Sp(4,s) assumed symmetry of arbitrary physical labels.

**Branch B — counterexample to A:** exhibit for an infinite s=2^h sequence a concrete correlated f_s,g_s with S_s=o(s^6), plus rigorous all-h bound. Such a witness invalidates A but is NOT by itself an R3 upper because uncounted positive GF5 four/six-coordinate classes may dominate. The actual strict extraction goal needs **same maps** R2=O(s^(26/5-eps2)) and entire R3=O(s^(6-eps3)).

**Branch C — model-equivalent reduction:** If neither A nor B closes, isolate an explicit incidence-tensor/cycle-pair-count inequality (with precise norms, constants, input label alphabet and restrictions) equivalent to one of the assertions. Establish spectral/cell-probe/rank limitations or explicit counterexamples with independent exact finite falsifiers. Do not label mere simulation a theorem.

## Required independent evidence

1. Index all 631 previously positive leading forest partition types and 11,032 subleading necessary shape types by original factor-endpoint partition (keep physical projections distinct). Finite exact counts for W32 E1-A are baseline only: lex U=(13,1,8,14), reverse-line U=(1,1,7,6), with fixed GF5 risk floors 1,656,350/51^6 and 724,680/51^6.
2. Compare D6, Q4, accepted single-cherry U_B and four NEW U counts ON ONE physical labeling. Optimize proxies only as declared *lower-risk surrogates*, never full R3.
3. For any theorem claim demand explicit s=2^h quantifiers, exact GF5 nonzero/checksum4 51-column palette, no assumed independence between correlated maps, no finite-h asymptotic fit.
4. Independent mathematical proof + two methods of oracle falsification, exact PR-head GitHub-hosted Research SUCCESS, postmerge main Research SUCCESS.
5. Status outcomes: PROVED_A, COUNTEREXAMPLE_B, RESTRICTED_THEOREM_C or OPEN_WITH_FORMAL_BLOCKER. No ASET exponent until full strict all-h estimates close.

Do not close #176 or #169 as a consequence of merely accepting E1-A. No Rust or external repo changes.

latestComment.body:
HYP-105 / issue #230 — AA4-SFC **all-h six-original-incidence-ID collision structure** implemented in [Draft PR #648](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/pull/648), exact head `e32d42f9b98d978387fa20b22ce6a6ff1d81a8c7`. Main unchanged; ROOT REMAINS **OPEN_WITH_FORMAL_BLOCKER** (no A/B/C theorem).

**Exact all-h new partial theorem (true symplectic W(3,2^h); arbitrary correlated COMPLETE separately globally injected POINT and LINE maps):** every coordinate-distinct directed physical 3-path whose two projected original source endpoint IDs form a genuinely nonincident (POINT q, LINE r) pair uses three distinct original source flags (also distinct point IDs, distinct line IDs). The unordered triple of source **incidence IDs** has exactly two directed paths with fixed original endpoint pair: path and full reverse. Any two DIFFERENT such reversal-orbits sharing the same endpoint pair have either 0 or 1 common original incidence ID, **never 2**: two common incidence IDs would induce two shared edges between the same fixed two end-coordinates of a simple physical coordinate 3-edge path, which forces the entire coordinate path on both sides and hence the same source-flag orbit.

Write P=sum_E N3, Q=sum_E N3². Let C0 = number of unordered pairs of distinct reversal-orbits with same original typed nonincident endpoints and **0** common source flag IDs (**six distinct original incidence IDs**); C1 similarly **1** common source flag ID (**five distinct IDs**). Then universally:
```
N3(q,r) is even;
Q=2P+8C0+8C1;
(Q_0,Q_1,Q_2,Q_3)=(8C0,8C1,0,2P).
```
New second independent *inverted source-flag postings* formula, m_alpha(q,r)=# reverse-orbits containing original source flag alpha:
```
C1 = sum_(q,r in E) sum_(alpha genuine original flag) binom(m_alpha(q,r),2)
C0 = sum_(q,r in E) binom(N3(q,r)/2,2) - C1.
```
This directly decomposes the open chi² target into five-ID and six-ID orbit collisions:
`chi²=U*(2P+8C0+8C1)/P²-1` for P>0. If *separately* P=Theta(U)=Theta(s^6), universal chi²=O(1) iff C0+C1=O(U). No such all-h bound proved.

**Independent exact true-source GF2/GF4 finite integer certificates** (walk-by-walk recovered source incidence IDs vs independent prior fixed-endpoint corner-join Q oracle, plus pairwise orbit intersection vs inverted flag posting):
- W(3,2) seed41: (P,Q,Q0,Q1,Q2,Q3,C0,C1)=(986,8612,4608,2032,0,1972,576,254).
- W(3,2) seed91: (860,6312,3224,1368,0,1720,403,171).
- W(3,4) explicit global full-label adversarial witness: (58730,676700,486880,72360,0,117460,60860,9045).
A zero-overlap pair of 3-paths has six true original incidence IDs, but may **fail the separate GF(5) palette/7-family acceptance filters** of root #230. Neither Q0 nor C0 is identified with the accepted original six-motif count.

[Mathematical proof and limits](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/blob/e32d42f9b98d978387fa20b22ce6a6ff1d81a8c7/docs/research/HYP-105-SIXFLAG-PATH-COLLISIONS.md); [true original source-ID oracle](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/blob/e32d42f9b98d978387fa20b22ce6a6ff1d81a8c7/research/hyp105_sixflag_pair_collision.py); [tests](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/blob/e32d42f9b98d978387fa20b22ce6a6ff1d81a8c7/research/test_hyp105_sixflag_pair_collision.py).

**Final exact-head CI:** [AA4-SFC specialized #40214446520](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/actions/runs/40214446520) COMPLETED SUCCESS; [INDEX #40214446489](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/actions/runs/40214446489) COMPLETED SUCCESS; full [Research #40214446504](https://github.com/definitely-stable/Mathlab/actions/runs/40214446504) QUEUED when checked, not called SUCCESS. Independent qualified proof-referee gate still required; keep Draft.

**Next P0:** derive actual upper bounds on source-original flag overlap occupancies m_alpha(q,r), especially C1, and disjoint six-original-ID C0, with arbitrary globally correlated maps; test whether these are O(U) against adversaries, and only then address full GF(5) seven-family accepted six-flag transfer.
